import pytest
from your_module import validate_password  # replace with actual module name

class TestValidatePassword:
    """Unit tests for validate_password function."""

    # --- Happy Path ---
    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "password",
        [
            "Abcdefg1",          # exactly 8 chars, mixed case, digit
            "A1b2C3d4",          # alternating
            "P@ssw0rd!",         # with special characters
            "ABCD1234abcd",      # longer string
            "aA1" + "b" * 20,    # length well above minimum
        ],
    )
    def test_valid_passwords(self, password):
        """Happy path: passwords that meet all requirements."""
        assert validate_password(password) is True

    # --- Edge Cases (return False) ---
    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "password,description",
        [
            # Length < 8
            ("Ab1", "too short, otherwise valid"),
            ("Abcdef1", "7 characters, otherwise valid"),
            ("A1a", "3 characters, all criteria met but short"),
            ("", "empty string"),
            # Missing uppercase
            ("abcdefg1", "no uppercase, length 8"),
            ("abcd1234", "no uppercase, length 8"),
            # Missing lowercase
            ("ABCDEFG1", "no lowercase, length 8"),
            ("ABCD1234", "no lowercase, length 8"),
            # Missing digit
            ("Abcdefgh", "no digit, length 8"),
            ("ABCDabcd", "no digit, length 8"),
            # Only one character type present
            ("12345678", "only digits"),
            ("abcdefgh", "only lowercase"),
            ("ABCDEFGH", "only uppercase"),
            # Exactly one missing with longer string
            ("abcdefghij1", "no uppercase, length > 8"),
            ("ABCDEFGHIJ1", "no lowercase, length > 8"),
            ("Abcdefghij", "no digit, length > 8"),
        ],
    )
    def test_invalid_passwords(self, password, description):
        """Edge cases: passwords that fail one or more requirements."""
        assert validate_password(password) is False, f"Failed for: {description}"

    # --- Error Cases (invalid input types) ---
    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "invalid_input",
        [
            None,
            12345678,
            3.14,
            [],
            {},
            object(),
        ],
    )
    def test_non_string_input_raises(self, invalid_input):
        """Error cases: non-string inputs should raise AttributeError or TypeError."""
        with pytest.raises((AttributeError, TypeError)):
            validate_password(invalid_input)

    # --- Additional Edge Cases ---
    def test_unicode_and_special_chars(self):
        """Valid password with unicode and special characters."""
        # Should work as ü is a letter (islower/isupper may vary depending on locale,
        # but for standard ASCII the function only looks at ASCII digits/letters logic)
        # Testing with standard ASCII upper/lower/digit is safe.
        assert validate_password("Aü1üüüüüü")  # ü.lower() is True, has length >=8

    def test_only_whitespace(self):
        """Whitespace does not count as upper/lower/digit."""
        assert validate_password("        ") is False  # 8 spaces
